name: SDN Public Query Flow
description: Gateway public query flow (mount /api/v1/query, loop G.5): foundation/http-route route_public_query decides the $HTQ request as a $QRP - POST -> "query" (SQL + typed PARAMETERS, or a named TIME_PROFILE over the unified OMM view, with sort / limit / representation), GET/HEAD -> "surface", anything else or an unservable body -> "refusal" (a $QRP Error straight to the responder); hostcap/flatsql-query sandbox_query (records delivered out of band by host body reference unless JSON is asked for) composes the effective SQL and runs it through the policy-mediated READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed hostcall (typed $PIV, capability storage_query; the engine enforces the sandbox in-wasm), or lists storage.query_surface, and answers the $QRP request beside its $QRP page (or a $QRP Error); foundation/http-respond respond_query renders the $HTR: the page stream verbatim as FlatBuffers by default, JSON on request, 304 on the page ETAG, the HTTP status of a refusal from its ERROR_CODE. foundation/omm-json is retired. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Sandboxed public raw SELECT over this node's FlatSQL engine (gateway loop G.5). Anonymous by design: abuse control is the in-engine sandbox (read-only authorizer, single-statement SELECT, statement timeout, row/byte caps), not authentication. The queryable surface is the engine hot window (recent records per standard x source), discoverable via GET.

routes.description: The public query surface, enumerated live from the engine (never hand-maintained): every readable relation (unified views like OMM with their _source column, per-source shadow tables like "OMM@celestrak-gp") with its columns (schema-exact names plus the _data record-BLOB column) and current hot-window record count, plus the effective sandbox caps (timeout_ms, max_rows, max_bytes). Everything OUTSIDE this listing is denied by the in-engine authorizer.

200.description: The queryable surface as one $QRP page header carrying TABLES and the serving limits (MAX_ELAPSED_MS / MAX_ROWS / MAX_BYTES). Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: Size-prefixed stream holding the $QRP page header.
{TABLES[{NAME, KIND, SOURCE, RECORDS, COLUMNS}], MAX_ELAPSED_MS, MAX_ROWS, MAX_BYTES}.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the page ETAG.

schema.description: $QRP (SDS QRP.fbs): the KIND Error record (ERROR_CODE / MESSAGE)

routes.description: Execute ONE read-only SELECT against this node's FlatSQL engine. Body: a JSON object {"sql": "SELECT ...", "params": [{"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v":...}], "format": "flatbuffer"|"json", "limit": N, "sort": "COLUMN [ASC|DESC]", "profile": "nearest"|"as_of"|"forward", "epoch": <unix seconds | RFC3339>, "source": "celestrak-gp"} or raw SQL text. sort/limit wrap the SQL (SELECT * FROM (sql) ORDER BY ... LIMIT ...); profile replaces sql with the engine's per-object epoch-profile query over the unified OMM view (default epoch = now, default limit 50000). SANDBOX (enforced in-wasm by the engine, defense-in-depth): reads restricted to the listed surface (GET this route) — control tables/sqlite_* denied; writes structurally impossible; single statement only; no PRAGMA/ATTACH/temp writes/transactions; statement timeout + row/byte caps REJECT oversized work (422). ENCODINGS: default flatbuffer requires an all-BLOB projection (typically SELECT _data ... — the frames are self-identifying size-prefixed record buffers); projections answer 406 — request format=json instead. format=json serves full-record results as the bare-array record presentation (schema-exact keys, OMM adapter) and tabular projections as an engine-assembled bare array keyed by the SQL column names verbatim. No rate limiting beyond the caps lives in the node — an operator fronts the gateway with a CDN/WAF for volumetric abuse (user decision, docs/gateway-api.md).

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding; wins over the body format field.

profile.description: Named per-object epoch profile over the unified OMM view (instead of sql).

epoch.description: Profile epoch: unix seconds number or RFC3339 string. Default now.

source.description: Profile source partition filter (shadow-table source name).

200.description: One $QRP page: whole records follow the page header (RECORD_COUNT, FILE_IDENTIFIER, ETAG), or a projection carries COLUMNS + ROWS. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: Size-prefixed stream: the $QRP page header, then its record frames.
A bare array: the records ($OMM), or {COLUMN: value} objects for a projection.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the page ETAG.

400.description: Validation: missing-sql, invalid-sort, invalid-profile, ambiguous-query, invalid-params, unsupported-parameter, query-failed (sandbox rejection or SQL error).
